title: 1885, April 14, Becaguimic train and highway Bridges
description: This photograph, taken on April 14, 1885, looks upriver toward the Becaguimic from the ice-jammed shore of the Saint John River. Despite the poor resolution, you can make out both the steel train bridge and the wooden highway bridge spanning the Becaguimic.
